description: This file defines a durable, persistent queue data structure with serialization and versioning support, including interfaces, implementation, and debugging views.

classes.name: IDurableQueue<T>
classes.description: Interface for a durable, persistent queue supporting standard queue operations and enumeration.

classes.name: DurableQueue<T>
classes.description: Implementation of a durable, versioned queue with serialization support, log application, and snapshot capabilities.

classes.name: DurableQueueDebugView<T>
classes.description: Debugging view class for inspecting the items in a DurableQueue instance.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.Clear
methods.description: Clears the queue.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the queue.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the queue items to an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.Dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the queue.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.Enqueue
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the queue.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.Peek
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.TryDequeue
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an item, returning success status.

methods.name: IDurableQueue<T>.TryPeek
methods.description: Attempts to peek at the front item without removing it.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.DurableQueue
methods.description: Constructor that registers the queue with a manager and initializes dependencies.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Reset
methods.description: Resets the queue state with a new storage log writer.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to modify the queue state based on command type.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Applies a snapshot to restore the queue state.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Clear
methods.description: Clears the queue and logs the clear command.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Peek
methods.description: Returns the item at the front without removing it.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.TryPeek
methods.description: Attempts to peek at the front item.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.CopyTo
methods.description: Copies items to an array.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item and logs the operation.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.Dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues an item and logs the operation.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.TryDequeue
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an item and logs if successful.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.ApplyEnqueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item internally.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.ApplyDequeue
methods.description: Dequeues an item internally.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.ApplyTryDequeue
methods.description: Attempts to dequeue an item internally.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.ApplyClear
methods.description: Clears the queue internally.

methods.name: DurableQueue<T>.GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the current storage log writer.

methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the queue (not implemented).
